note: ContentGuardClassifier.check(text) -> {action allow|review|block, flagged, uncertain, scores}. One noul per dimension, keyed by dimension name, in dimension order. flagged = dimensions with band yes; uncertain = band uncertain or missing (both in dimension order); scores = p per answered dimension. block if any flagged, else review if any uncertain, else allow. Error: open -> allow, closed -> block (flagged/uncertain empty, scores {}). The beforeLLM hook raises `content guard blocked: <flagged joined by ", ">` (or `content guard blocked: classifier error`) on block and otherwise delegates.
